summary: The purpose of this report is to request authority to amend four (4) existing contracts under the Union Station Revitalization Project (USRP).
decided: City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. In accordance with Section 71-11.1.1.C of the City of Toronto Municipal Code (Financial Control By-law), City Council authorize amendment of existing contracts, in accordance with the details as specified below: a. NORR Limited, Architects and Engineers, Purchase Order 6030175, in the additional amount of up to $1.5 million, net of all taxes, revising the current contract authority from $41.0 million, net of all taxes, up to a potential value of $42.5 million, net of all taxes, to provide required additional design and construction services; b. WSP Canada Group Limited, Contract 47020883, in the additional amount of up to $1.5 million, net of all taxes, revising the current contract authority from $6.4 million, net of all taxes, up to a potential value of $7.9 million, net of all taxes, to continue to provide contract administration services and expertise through the construction duration; c. Bondfield Construction Company Limited, Purchase Order 6041873, in the additional amount of up to $8.8 million, net of all taxes, revising the current contract authority from $207.2 million, net of all taxes, up to a potential value of $216.0 million, net of all taxes, to provide construction services for the completion of the Union Station Revitalization Project; and d.
